load_amass_motion: load an AMASS npz motion capture file into a fairmotion Motion object using a SMPL body model path
load_amass_motion_parallel: load multiple AMASS npz files in parallel using a configurable number of CPU cores
create_skeleton_from_amass_bodymodel: create a fairmotion Skeleton from a SMPL body model, betas, joint count, and joint names
create_motion_from_amass_data: create a fairmotion Motion object from an AMASS npz file and a loaded SMPL body model
load_smpl_body_model: load a SMPL or SMPL-H body model from a file path with configurable beta count
